||VM|| Technical Issues #2
Also gone.
~Lexi

There is a bug on the server, people do not get payday. No payday means no SQL saving.

In other words NOTHING you do is saved on the server unless you disconnect. So if server is restarted or crashes you loose anything you made in the time inbetween joining and the crash/restart.
